title: Single recorded peer content on SciTaT, Haiku

notes: Three-cell extension: a repeated false-endorsement anchor, an unsupported correct rejection, and an evidence-backed correction.
The source identity, record position, confidence, retrieval capacity, task, live-agent roles, 12 speaking orders, seed, and call budget are fixed.
All six live agents are neutral and answer once. The primary endpoint is the first exposed agent's stance in each run. All six responses are secondary.
The repeated endorsement cell checks for drift relative to the released single-peer experiment. The two correction cells are new.
The stopping rule was fixed before launch at 36 runs. No extension is triggered by interim results.
